title: BattleTech source provenance 1.0.0
description: Original source identities only; independent of design identity/revision, calculations and campaign state. This schema does not establish source availability, truth or construction-family support.

sources.description: Ordered source rows, retained without deduplication; multiple origins may describe one design. Order does not define design identity.

repository.description: Stable credential-free HTTPS repository identity, including repository path; no query, fragment or trailing slash. Identity is asserted, not fetched by validation.

commit.description: Resolved full lowercase Git commit object ID, never a ref or abbreviation.

path.description: Exact case-sensitive repository-relative POSIX path. No absolute paths, empty/dot/traversal segments, backslashes, colons or control characters. Never URL-decode or normalize before comparison.

blob.description: Full lowercase Git blob object ID of the original bytes; uses the same Git object format as commit. Distinct from SHA-256 of file bytes.

originalName.description: Original upload basename, preserved exactly; no filesystem path or invented Git identity.

originalFormat.description: Source syntax, independent of filename case or extension. Declaring a syntax does not establish parser or family support.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact original file bytes, before decoding, newline normalization or parsing; not a normalized design digest or Git object ID.

metadata.description: Optional opaque annotations. Preserve order and values. They impose no requirements and cannot override source identity, version or any core semantics. Required semantic extensions are unsupported.

name.description: Reverse-DNS namespace plus colon and annotation key, for example org.example:note.
